about: The palettes Matt Fisher made for the fractal wallpapers project (https://techmatt.github.io/fractals/tools-and-data/). Each palette is cyclic: its stops run from position 0 to position 1 and the color at 1 is the color at 0. `stops` lists the colors as sRGB hex, evenly spaced, so stop i of n sits at position i / (n - 1); a renderer interpolates between neighbors. Released under CC0 1.0.
